visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a woman with long brownish hair, wearing a sheer grey top over a green inner shirt, holding a pink 'Wild But Cutie' blind box. She smiles brightly and gestures excitedly with her hands, which have silver manicured nails. The background is a soft-lit indoor setting with a grey sofa and colorful plush toys. (2) She tilts the box forward to show the 'CryBaby' branding and the leopard-print cat character illustration on the front. Her facial expressions are highly animated with wide smiles and active eyebrows. (3) The scene cuts to her opening the large outer box, revealing six smaller pink individual blind boxes inside. She points at them and looks directly into the camera. (4) An on-screen graphic appears showing six different cat-themed plushies stacked together, representing the possible collection. (5) She begins unboxing the individual packets, which are small white drawstring bags. She pulls out a white and brown leopard-print cat plushie with blue teardrop eyes. (6) She reveals more plushies in sequence: a green moss-colored cat, a white fluffy cat, and a lavender purple cat. She holds each one close to the lens for detail. (7) She notices some loose brown threads on a pink plushie and brings it very close to the camera for a macro inspection, looking concerned. (8) She then realizes the threads are part of the cat's whiskers and laughs, showing a split-screen comparison of different plushies' whiskers. (9) She stacks four plushies vertically on top of each other, balancing them with her hands. (10) Finally, she unboxes a grey cat plushie and holds it up alongside the others, waving goodbye to the camera with a joyful expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy introduction with a fast-tempo, synth-pop BGM. The speaker's voice is high-pitched and bright, greeting the audience. (2) A transition whoosh SFX occurs as she presents the box. Vocal intensity remains high and enthusiastic. (3) Soft plastic rustling is heard as she opens the outer box, followed by a 'pop' SFX emphasizing the reveal. (4) During the unboxing of individual plushies, 'ding' SFX and cartoonish bubble sounds are layered over the rhythmic BGM to mark each new discovery. (5) A slight shift in vocal tone occurs when she examines the 'defect', characterized by slower speech and a questioning intonation, accompanied by a comedic slide SFX. (6) Vocal tone returns to high arousal and happiness as she clarifies the design. (7) The final phase features a energetic outro with the BGM swelling slightly in volume and a high-pitched farewell greeting.
